readerCopy.body: A new opportunity can touch the exact place where you still doubt yourself and still be worth taking. When Chiron conjuncts the North Node, a chance to move forward may resemble an earlier experience that left you embarrassed, rejected, or convinced you were not ready. You do not need to feel completely healed before you use what you learned. Let the old experience inform your preparation and sharpen your boundaries, but do not let what happened before make the final decision for you.
